BUG2 (emergent-badge): document.getElementById('emergent-badge') === null on '/', '/admin', and mobile viewport — PASS. BUG3 (sticky-card overlap): scrolled each card to its sticky pin position (stickyTop 96/116/136) — computed geometry shows card1 bottom-right tile bottom=616 vs next card top=685 (69px gap, no overlap), card2 last tile bottom=627 vs next card top=680 (53px gap, no overlap), card3 last tile bottom=640 (last card, no next) — PASS. REGRESSION: WhatsApp hrefs verified on nav-lets-talk, hero-lets-talk, bottom-nav-cta, contact-whatsapp, lightbox-whatsapp (all wa.me/919266553033). POST /api/contact returned 200 and contact-success toast rendered. /admin route unlocked with key 'tanmay-admin-2026'. No console errors related to the fixes (only 2 harmless 403s for external analytics-style resources, plus 1 pre-existing framer-motion useScroll warning noted in iteration_1).

critical_code_review_comments: Duplication: The 'stripBadge' useEffect is repeated verbatim in both App() and Portfolio() (App.js lines 21-33 and 77-86) — extract into a small custom hook (useStripEmergentBadge) or run only once at App level to reduce ~13 lines of duplication.

WorkLightbox.jsx: When active video fails to load, onError sets style.display='none' but the fallback branch is not rendered, leaving an empty black canvas. Consider using useState errored flag (like VideoTile in Work.jsx) to render a gradient fallback and keep the Reel N/N badge legible.

Work.jsx StickyCard uses hard-coded stickyTop = 96 + index * 20 and minHeight = 'min(1080px, 130vh)'. The overlap fix works at 1080p tested here, but on very tall viewports (>1300px) the min(1080px,130vh) can shrink below card height. Consider making minHeight relative to the card content (e.g., calc(100vh + 20%)) for robustness.
Accessibility: WorkLightbox lacks role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' on the fixed container; screen-reader users get no dialog semantics. Trivial add.

Performance: All 4 thumbnails render <video> with preload='metadata' inside the lightbox. On mobile 4G, that's 4 concurrent range-GETs each open. Consider poster fallbacks and only mounting an iframe/video for the active thumbnail on mobile.

rca of the issue: No issues found. Fix quality notes: (1) Lightbox — clean prev/next wrap-around, correct keyboard (Escape, Arrow keys) handling, body scroll lock during open. (2) Badge stripping — belt-and-suspenders (setInterval every 500ms for 5s + index.css hide). Works even if script re-injects. (3) Overlap — new minHeight: min(1080px,130vh) + tuned card layout (aspect-video / aspect-[16/11] on main, aspect-[3/4] side tiles) gives ~70px breathing gap between last tile bottom and next card sticky-top at 1080p, so bottom tile stays fully visible during pin.
